description: Run one read-only SELECT over staged disclosure tables, materialize the complete result, then retrieve whole rows by result_table and next_offset without rerunning SQL. Inspect columns with uslobbying_dataframe_describe first.

canvas_id.description: Canvas token returned by a disclosure analytical tool.

offset.description: Canonical row offset for result_table, default zero.

register_as.description: Fresh result table name for a new SQL call; omit for a generated name.

result_table.description: Previously materialized result table; exclusive with sql and register_as.

row_limit.description: Maximum whole rows in this response; positive integers clamp to 100, then to any lower provider ceiling.

sql.description: One read-only SELECT; exclusive with result_table and offset.

name: uslobbying_dataframe_query

describe_tool.description: Inspect exact table schemas before SQL.

query_tool.description: Query or retrieve materialized table rows.

complete.description: Whether every intended row is registered.

grain.description: Meaning of one row; activity rows have no money.

delivery_limits.description: Clamped controls for this call; an empty map means no clamp. Immediate cursor replay retains its original values.

describe_tool.description: Inspect exact table schemas before SQL.

effective_row_limit.description: Effective row limit when a delivery or provider ceiling lowers the requested limit.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: New SQL and result-table selectors are missing or combined. `canvas_unavailable`: Canvas is not configured. `canvas_not_found`: Canvas token is unknown or expired. `missing_table`: Named table is absent or expired. `invalid_sql`: SQL binding fails. `sql_parse_error`: SQL parsing fails. `sql_execution_error`: SQL execution or conversion fails. `non_select_statement`: SQL is not SELECT. `multi_statement`: SQL contains multiple statements. `denied_function`: SQL uses a prohibited function. `sql_read_only`: SQL violates read-only execution. `plan_operator_not_allowed`: SQL plan contains a prohibited operator. `register_as_clash`: Requested result name already exists. `query_row_too_large`: One complete row or metadata exceeds the wire budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

output_complete.description: Whether this result has no remaining delivery rows.

query_tool.description: Query or retrieve materialized table rows.

row_order.description: Delivery orders by all materialized values.

truncated.description: More materialized rows remain; continue with next_offset.
